frontmatter.description: How the spider robot's brain thinks before it acts or answers. Adapted from the JobHunt agent-reasoning loop for a body that moves in the real world. Find the real goal, use memory and sensors before guessing, weigh physical consequences, verify, decide with calibrated confidence, and close the loop. Always on.
